$comment: A topic: one of a collection's category terms. Every collection that has categories (contract/sections.json) stores its terms as topics and keeps its own list (the founder's ruling of 18/11/2026, question 5). Topics are flat: no parent. The archive draws a topic's description (markup/archive.json). On WordPress a topic is a term of the source's taxonomy (SOURCE_DEFAULTS in emit/acf.mjs), so both fields are native and no ACF field is generated; WordPress's default category (Uncategorised) is never drawn as a topic.

wordpress.owes: the parent control removed from each taxonomy, so topics stay flat

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional. Shown at the top of the topic's archive.

nextjs.owes: the field on each topics collection in core
